Next, we want to see yours. 
Here's how you enter for a chance to win a brand new strap for your DW watch:

1) take a fun and creative selfie, and make sure that your Daniel Wellington watch is in the photo.

2) upload it to Instagram and tag it with #DWelfie.

3) tag three friends in your photo and encourage them to post a #DWelfie to improve your chances of winning. (Please note that this is not a required step)

4) Done.

Best of luck!

It's #DWelfie time! 
This week, as we continue to celebrate the "Month of Another Million" (#DWMOAM), we want to see your best DWelfies, or Daniel Wellington selfies.

How to enter:
1) take a fun selfie, featuring you and your Daniel Wellington timepiece.

2) upload it to Instagram and simply tag it with #DWelfie.

3) tag three friends in your photo and encourage them to post a #DWelfie to improve your chances of winning. (Please note that this is not a required step)

4) Done!

We will repost the three most creative photos at the end of the contest, and those followers will win a strap of their choice. The contest closes on Sunday, March 27.

Good luck!
